title: [DOC2-17] Purview bridge describes the retired group-encrypted attachment blob
description: Review finding DOC2-17: Purview bridge describes the retired group-encrypted attachment blob (lens DOC2). Location: profiles/purview-bridge.md:300; spec/05-messaging.md:317. Fix: Replace "CID of a group-encrypted blob ... Only a group member can decrypt it" with content-key decryption using the captured Message's `contentKey`, verified against `sha256`. Note that Exchange items carrying the Message are plaintext-equivalent for attachments. The logger's fetch duty depends on the DOC2-4 spec fix. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
close_reason: Guides and purview profile now describe attachment capture per spec §7 and §14.3.4
